NightSky - night environment lighting, sky, moon, light cookies and glow sprites
Fetched and generated October 14, 2026. Machine-readable details (sha256, mirrors, commits): sources.json.

Poly Haven and NASA hosts were not reachable from the build container, so every downloaded file
came from a pinned GitHub mirror (git or media.githubusercontent.com for Git LFS) and was checked
against the official size or hash where one was available (see "Verified" below).

    "CC0 assets carry no attribution requirement whatsoever, now or ever."

    (authors "Greg Zaal, Jenelle van Heerden") and modern_evening_street (author "Grzegorz Wronkowski").

2. NASA imagery - public domain (U.S. Government work); credit requested
==============================================================================================
moon.jpg   (byte-identical copy of lroc_color_poles_2k.jpg)
  Title: CGI Moon Kit, colour map "lroc_color_poles" (2k equirectangular).
  Creator: NASA's Scientific Visualization Studio (Ernie Wright, USRA), NASA Goddard Space Flight Center;
           imagery from the Lunar Reconnaissance Orbiter Camera (LROC) WAC, NASA/GSFC/Arizona State University.
  Original: https://svs.gsfc.nasa.gov/4720
  Mirror: https://github.com/nasa/virgo (NASA's own repository) @ a9d88e68af30cbe2075e05b083cff49681014a0f,
          images/moon/lroc_color_poles_2k.jpg (Git LFS); the folder README says "Images in this dir came
          from https://svs.gsfc.nasa.gov/4720".
  Licence: NASA imagery is not protected by copyright in the United States (NASA Images and Media Usage
  Guidelines, https://www.nasa.gov/nasa-brand-center/images-and-media/); do not use NASA logos or imply
  endorsement. Attribution to show in credits: "Moon imagery: NASA's Scientific Visualization Studio (CGI Moon Kit)".
moon_disc_512.png
  Derived by the project from lroc_color_poles_4k.jpg (same mirror and commit, sha256 cbefba7d...c2df4):
  orthographic near-side projection, 40% desaturation, slight limb darkening, alpha disc.
  Same NASA credit applies; the project's own changes are dedicated CC0.

==============================================================================================
3. Project-generated assets - project-owned, dedicated CC0 1.0 (no third-party material)
==============================================================================================
city_night_sky_clear_2k.hdr, city_night_sky_overcast_1k.hdr  (Generators~/gen_skies.py)
cookie_flashlight_led_512.png, cookie_uv_torch_512.png, cookie_streetlight_512.png,
cookie_scene_floodlight_512.png, glow_soft_256.png, glow_starburst_512.png, flare_streak_512x128.png,
flare_halo_ring_256.png, lens_dirt_1024.png  (Generators~/gen_sprites.py)
Generators~/*.py (hdrio.py, gen_skies.py, gen_sprites.py, make_moon_disc.py, downsample_hdr.py)
  Original procedural work made for AlKoda's Jewelry-store-vr-demo with numpy and Pillow. No downloaded
  images. Free to use, modify and redistribute.
  The star field in city_night_sky_clear_2k.hdr is drawn from factual catalogue data (positions,
  magnitudes, colour temperatures) of the Yale Bright Star Catalogue, 5th Revised Ed. (Hoffleit D.,
  Warren Jr W.H., NSSDC/ADC 1991), read from the JSON conversion bsc5-short.json in
  https://github.com/brettonw/YaleBrightStarCatalog @ abffb3b7223ae37e879b0a3ff5b49ad06aed5576.
  That conversion is "MIT License, Copyright (c) 2016 Bretton Wade"; the JSON file itself is NOT
  redistributed in this pack (it is only an input to the generator).

==============================================================================================
Rejected or not used (see README.md): three.js lensflare textures (CC BY-NC-SA 3.0), three.js
lensdirt.png (no licence statement), NASA Deep Star Maps 2020 (includes ESA Gaia DR2 data with its
own credit terms), Solar System Scope textures (CC BY 4.0, not needed), Shanghai Bund and
Potsdamer Platz HDRIs (identifiable skylines/brand signage), @pmndrs/assets HDRIs (CC0 but 512x256 only).
